Measured so far — 'gold knee plates' (head noun + modifier) landed in full; 'gold-trimmed brown leather bracers' (head noun + STACKED compound modifier) landed its head noun and dropped the modifier.
_change: Exactly one edit against the bracer run's prompt: 'gold-trimmed brown leather bracers' becomes 'brown leather bracers, a gold plate on each outer forearm'. The trim is promoted from an adjective to its own noun phrase. Everything else is byte-identical, so the promotion is the only variable. Deliberately NOT the full 16-element spec — that would grow the prompt by five terms and confound the grammar change with competition for attention.
_stopping_rule: One roll. If the promoted phrase also drops the plate, the specification premise is weaker than Amendment 12 assumed, Arm B waits, and this is reported rather than reworded.
